name: What type of paint is best for rental properties?

mainEntity.name: What type of paint is best for rental properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: For rental properties, durable, washable paints are generally recommended. Eggshell or satin finishes are popular choices for walls because they offer a slight sheen that makes them more resistant to scuffs and easier to clean than flat paints. Semi-gloss is often used for trim, doors, and baseboards due to its high durability and ease of cleaning. We typically suggest neutral, light colors to appeal to a wider range of prospective tenants and make the space feel larger and brighter.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable, washable paints like eggshell or satin finishes are best for walls, with semi-gloss for trim, usually in neutral colors.
